lanbakery_baker.text: Morning! Warm out of the oven. Lancashire folk are mad about Chorley cakes, which are flat, full of currants and a bit plain.
Eccles cakes are the flaky ones. We eat them with a slice of crumbly Lancashire cheese, and I will not hear otherwise.

then.text: You have had your cake, my love. Off you go before the cats smell it.

else.text: Take one for the road. Mind the pastry flakes. They get everywhere, especially on cats.
